title: Streamline deco
when: Premieres, launches, cities, travel and anything that should feel like an invitation

voice.style: smooth, assured, a touch of glamour

rules: Every surface is a gradient, never an outline: airbrushed skies, lit faces, shadowed sides. Strokes only as thin gold rules.
Symmetry and rays: a sunburst (the sunburst sketch) behind the subject, stepped towers either side, the subject on the axis.
Gold is light: the accent takes shine (a sweep across the title) and glow on windows and spires.
Type is wide-tracked caps (tracking 0.2–0.4) in the serif display face, centred.
Move slowly and symmetrically: push in on the axis, rise up a tower, iris at the chapter turn.
